description: Expand an IPv6 address to its full 8-group form and compress it to its RFC 5952 canonical shortest form, classify its address type (loopback, link-local, unique-local, multicast, IPv4-mapped, documentation, or global unicast), and separate out an optional zone ID. Understands an embedded IPv4 suffix like "::ffff:192.168.1.1".

address.description: The IPv6 address to expand/compress, e.g. "2001:db8::ff00:42:8329"

name: parse_ipv6_address
